notes.title: Vile 1.4
notes.notes:
Fixed bug with description on Prodigious Artifact talent.
Improved hitbox of Demon Hunter's scythe
Various minor adjustments.

notes.title: Vile 1.3
notes.notes: Bug fixes and difficulty adjustments.

notes.title: Vile 1.2
notes.notes: Difficulty Adjustments, Bug fixes, and various improvements.

notes.title: Vile 1.1 Bug fixes
notes.notes: Fixed Shop bugs.

notes.title: Vile 1.0 has launched!
notes.notes: Various typo, and bug fixes.

notes.title: Vile 0.99 Patch! New objective and various improvements!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New objective: Destroy the Giant Eggs!
[*] Various bug fixes and minor enemy adjustments made.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.95 Patch! New Objective
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New objective: Extinguish flames to unlock the caged beast!
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.94.2 Patch! More Souls and Achievements fully work.
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Earlier level enemies now have a chance to drop bigger souls.
[*] Achievements will be granted to those who have already earned them.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.94.1 Patch! New objective added and Achievement fixes!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New objective added.
[*] Achievements should work now. Testing to see if they give the achievements to players if they already would have had them.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.94 Patch! Boss Mode Added!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New Boss Mode. Play against the bosses you have seen and earn souls if you defeat them.
[*] Boss Mode is available on the map.
[*] Lots of bug fixes. 
[*] Fixed a lot of typos in multiple languages.
[/list]

We are aware that steam achievements are not always working and figuring out what is going on. Hope to figure it out soon!

notes.title: Vile 0.93.1 Patch! New UI, Bug fixes, improvements, and translations!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New UI. It is cleaner looking and takes less room.
[*] Lots of bug fixes.
[*] Added New Languages. Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and Portuguese.
[/list]

There might be minor errors in the Languages. If you spot any feel free to let us know.

notes.title: New patch will be arriving soon.
notes.notes:
We have been working on translating the game into more languages, improved ui, and lots of bug fixes.

Translating and adjusting the game for the translations is taking more time than we had thought. 

The new UI makes room for more screen while still having all the information needed.

We are aware of the obvious bugs and they have been fixed.

Thanks for being patient.

notes.title: Vile 0.93 Patch! New Objective and Translations added!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New Objective added, Destroy the Sentries.
[*] Game Translated in French and German.
[*] Fixed a bug where portal projectiles were not able to be hit by abilities.
[*] Fixed a couple of minor bugs.
[/list]

We didn't plan efficiently for translations which is the reason it is taking us awhile to translate but there will be more completed soon and more content.

notes.title: Vile 0.92.2 Patch! New Objective!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New objective added."Collect Demon Trophies" Once the player has collected one an elite demon spawns!
[*] Various bug fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.92.1 Patch! Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed starting with low hp and mana on 2nd part of forest map.
[*] Haunted forest part 2 is clickable with mouse fixed.
[*] Fixed invisible wall on "Summon and defeat the demon" objective
[*] Fixed objective text that wouldn't appear sometimes.
[*] Slightly lowered hp of certain enemies on Castle and Cave Map.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.92! Patch! New objective added!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New objective. Hunt Spirits
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.91.3 Patch! Screen shakes can be turned off!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Screen Shakes can be turned on/off in the Options Menu.
[*] Fixed being able to move through the main menu while "Play Tutorial" was in front.
[*] Demonic Tree Boss projectiles slightly slower.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.91.2 Patch! New gun!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New gun, Pumpkin Launcher!
[*] Dynamite now drops when picking up new artifacts.
[*] Haunted Forest and Wasteland enemies projectiles are slower.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.91.1 Patch! Equipment drops, Camera change, and More!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] When you pick up a gun/artifact then the one equipped will drop on the ground. [u]Note: Dynamite can't be dropped atm and will be patched in a day or two.[/u]
[*] Camera extends more with crosshair to see further ahead.
[*] Increased duration of guns/artifacts.
[*] Pink Death Bug and Demonic Rhino on Haunted Forest are slightly weaker.
[*] Player 2 animation bugs fixed
[*] When entering a boss portal the player gains slightly more hp and mp.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.91 Patch! New Map, Objective, and more.
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New Map has been added. New and improved.
[*] New saves after each boss so players don't have to beat the same boss twice.
[*] New Objective. "Find the Chalices"
[*] Ammo, hp, mp, and weapons stay out longer.
[*] If playing for the first time then players can choose if they want to play the tutorial or not.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile 0.90.1 Patch! Tutorial Added!
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Tutorial added after intro when first playing the game. It is also in Options.
[*] Slightly decreased screen shakes.
[*] Souls are transparent.
[/list]

notes.title: Vile Early Access Officially Launched
notes.notes:
We are very happy to finally have Vile playable for everyone. We spent a lot of our free time developing and polishing the game. We hope that you will enjoy playing Vile as we do. 

This is the Early Access version of the game and we want to add more content and features. We hope to hear feedback from the community on the Steam community discussions: https://steamcommunity.com/app/961420/discussions/ or email ardentsquid@gmail.com

We hope to have a new update in a couple of dates as we are always improving the game constantly.

Have a great day,
Ardentsquid
